title: group_limited_topk used hardcoded k=2 instead of num_groups/group_topk
root_cause: group_limited_topk computed group_scores as scores.view(num_tokens, num_groups, -1).topk(2, dim=-1)[0].sum(dim=-1) — the k=2 was hardcoded instead of using num_groups//group_topk. This produced wrong group scores and therefore wrong group selection for token-to-expert routing in DeepSeek-style models.
invariant: group_scores must equal sum of top-(num_groups//group_topk) routing scores within each group (correctness check on the topk k value).
diff_summary: Changed .topk(2, dim=-1) to .topk(num_groups // group_topk, dim=-1) in group_limited_topk.
